parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time when the function is invoked. The value is in the **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT** format.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The trace ID of the request for Function Compute API.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description:
The order in which the returned versions are sorted. Valid values:

*   **FORWARD**: The results are sorted in ascending order.
*   **BACKWARD**: The results are sorted in descending order.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100. The number of returned configurations is less than or equal to the specified number.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: The token required to obtain more results. If the number of layers exceeds the limit, the nextToken parameter is returned. You can include the parameter in subsequent calls to obtain more results. You do not need to provide this parameter in the first call.

parameters.name: startKey
parameters.description: The position from which the list begins. Results are sorted based on the version numbers.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open list-service-versions --service-name demo-service --limit 20 --next-token 8bj81uI8n0000 --start-key nextservice --direction BACKWARD --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id rid281s000000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fc-open GET /2021-04-06/services/demo-service/versions --region cn-hangzhou --startKey nextservice --nextToken 8bj81uI8n0000 --limit 20 --direction BACKWARD --header "X-Fc-Date=Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT" --header "X-Fc-Trace-Id=rid281s000000" --header "X-Fc-Account-Id=1880770869020000" --header "Content-Type=application/json"
